bio.text: Ileana Garcia has represented District 36 in the Florida Senate since being elected in 2020.

The Senate biography lists Garcia as a Hispanic American radio and TV personality for over 20 years in South Florida, and notes service as a deputy press secretary in the U.S. Department of Homeland Security's Office of Public Affairs.
Garcia was born in Miami and graduated from Miami Senior High School in 1987.
